pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal dark regions with moderately smooth pixel gradients along edges. Individual patches exhibit heterogeneous shapes with four-to-six vertices and variable surface area across the focal plane.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent or quad-valent. Pathways maintain a narrow and relatively uniform pixel width throughout the visible topology.
